svg.aria-label: Consistent hashing ring. Before: servers s0 to s3 and keys k0 to k3 sit on a ring, and each key goes clockwise to the first server. After adding s4 between s3 and s0, only the keys in the range from s3 to s4 (here just k0) move to s4; every other key stays put.
svg.title: Hash ring: adding a server
